rows.en: (Ranka and I made plans to hang out today, but...)
(I wonder what happened. She's late...)

*pant, pant*...
I-I'm so sorry, I'm late again!
rows.notes: Ranka, both genders (also late in frd_rnk_001).

rows.en: It's fine, I haven't been waiting that long.
Wait, that outfit...
rows.notes: Player, both genders; Ranka is in her Nyan-Nyan uniform.

rows.en:
Yes... I was working at Nyan-Nyan until just now,
but a lot of people are off today...
Actually, I have to go back and help after this...
So that means today...
I-I'm so sorry!

I see. Well, that's too bad, but it can't be helped.
You could've just called me, though.

No, I felt I should at least
tell you in person...
I see. Thanks for coming all this way to tell me.
Well then, I'll get back to work!
Ah! Wait a sec!
Yes? What is it?

If you want, I'll help out
at your job too.

I'm free anyway.
And it's been a while since I went to Nyan-Nyan.
No, but...
If it's not a bother, that is...

It's no bother at all!
Then I'll take you up on it!
\p-kun, thanks for all your hard work!

Wow~, Nyan-Nyan sure is popular.
It was way more than I expected...

Yes, it's always busy,
and when people take the day off on top of that,
it ends up like this...
Well, anyway, great work today.

Oh, that's right!
Here, a thank-you for today: "maguro buns"!
rows.notes: Ranka, both genders. Glossary maguro bun.

rows.en: Wow, thank you!

No, thank YOU for helping
me out with work!
Nah, it was my first time, but it was fun.

Next time, come as a customer, okay?
I'll give you extra-special service!
Ahahaha, thanks!

(It was way harder than I expected,
but it was fun.)

(Ranka-chan and I made plans
to hang out today, but...)
It's fine, I haven't been waiting that long.

I see. Well, that's too bad, but it can't be helped.
You could've just called me, though.
I see. Thanks for coming all this way to tell me.

If you want, I'll help out
at your job too.

I'm free anyway, and I thought it'd be nice
to go to Nyan-Nyan after so long.
\p-chan, great work today!

Wow~, Nyan-Nyan sure is popular.
It might've been more than I expected...
Nah, it was my first time, but it was really fun.
Yeah, I'll come as a customer next time!

(It was way harder than I expected,
but it was fun~)

(Ranka and I are going out to have fun today.
Where should we go?)

\p-kuuun!
Over here!!
Ranka, you're here already?

Yes, I've been really
looking forward to today.
Hearing you say that makes it worth inviting you.
So, where are we going to have fun today?

Phew~
We really played our hearts out, huh?
Yeah, I'm totally wiped out.
Ahaha, you're such a wimp!

(Hanging out with Ranka all day
was a nice change of pace.)

(Ranka-chan and I are going out to have fun today.
Where should we go?)

\p-chaaan!
Over here!!
Ranka-chan, you're here already?
Hearing you say that makes it worth inviting you.
Yeah, my legs are killing me.
Well then, shall we head home~?

(Hanging out with Ranka-chan all day
was a nice change of pace.)
(Today Ranka and I came to Island 3 to have fun!)
This soft serve is so good~!
rows.notes: Ranka, both genders. Review: 'soft serve' unhyphenated throughout.

rows.en:
Apparently they make it with
fresh hippo-cow milk.
You can't get this taste anywhere but here!
I wonder where the hippo-cows are?
It's a bit of a walk, but do you want to go see them?
Alright, let's go check them out!
Wow! Zentradi people are raising them!
They're huge...
rows.notes: Male; 'they' covers the hippo-cows or the Zentradi keepers (Japanese has no subject).

rows.en: Let's go see!
Huh? Well, um, hmm...
You've totally got to see them up close!
Okay, okay.

Hey, hey!
Its big round eyes are gazing at me!
\p-kun! Isn't it cute?!

It's so cute~
I want to keep one~!
I think feeding it would cost a fortune...

I'll just cut down on Big Bro's meals,
so it'll be fine.
Whaaat?!

Come on, \p-kun!!
Let's play with Mr. Hippo-cow some more!!
rows.notes: Ranka, male. kabaushi-kun rendered 'Mr. Hippo-cow' (affectionate suffix on an animal, not a name).

rows.en: Haah~, today was so much fun!
Hearing you say that makes it worth inviting you.

Ah?! Look at the time...
Big Bro will worry,
so I'll head home now!

uncertain: c12745: Ranka's kabaushi-kun (honorific on an animal, not a person's name) rendered 'Mr. Hippo-cow'; the female twin (c12758) and kabaushi-san (c12767) in slice 174 do the same. If the honorific rule should cover animals too, it would be 'hippo-cow-kun' / 'hippo-cow-san'.
c12735: 'They're huge...' with no subject in the Japanese; it follows Ranka's line about Zentradi keepers raising the hippo-cows, so 'they' fits either.
